title: Coding agents
intro: Plan, implement, test and review software changes.
buyer_guidance: Compare repository permissions, execution environments, tests, review controls and the artifact returned. An opened pull request is different from an accepted change.
seo_title: Coding agents: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Plan, implement, test and review software changes.

title: Browser and computer agents
intro: Find agents and infrastructure for work in browsers and desktop applications.
buyer_guidance: Separate the model-driven agent from its browser runtime. Check authentication, session persistence, downloads, approval boundaries and recovery when page layouts change.
seo_title: Browser and computer agents: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Find agents and infrastructure for work in browsers and desktop applications.

title: Customer support agents
intro: Explore customer-service agents and supporting workflows.
buyer_guidance: Evaluate policy grounding, identity checks, escalation and write permissions. A helpful answer and an executed refund require different controls.
seo_title: Customer support agents: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore customer-service agents and supporting workflows.

title: Sales and customer research agents
intro: Explore prospecting, qualification, customer research and revenue workflows.
buyer_guidance: Separate research and drafting from sending. Compare source traceability, suppression handling, CRM permissions and the approval needed for external communications.
seo_title: Sales and customer research agents: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore prospecting, qualification, customer research and revenue workflows.

title: Business operations agents
intro: Explore work across email, calendars, internal systems and enterprise processes.
buyer_guidance: Start with a bounded workflow and an explicit acceptance rule. Ask what happens when a required system is unavailable or an approval is declined.
seo_title: Business operations agents: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore work across email, calendars, internal systems and enterprise processes.

title: Finance and accounting agents
intro: Explore financial research, accounting and operational workflows.
buyer_guidance: Distinguish analytical output from accounting entries or transactions. Require source records, reconciliation rules, exception handling and a named reviewer.
seo_title: Finance and accounting agents: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore financial research, accounting and operational workflows.

title: Legal and professional agents
intro: Explore document and knowledge workflows for professional teams.
buyer_guidance: Check provenance, jurisdictional context, confidentiality and review obligations. A cited draft does not establish that its authorities are current or applicable.
seo_title: Legal and professional agents: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore document and knowledge workflows for professional teams.

title: Healthcare workflow agents
intro: Explore healthcare administration and clinical-adjacent workflows.
buyer_guidance: Separate administrative work, documentation and clinical decisions. Check the vendor-described scope and require the appropriate clinical and privacy review.
seo_title: Healthcare workflow agents: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore healthcare administration and clinical-adjacent workflows.

title: Procurement agents
intro: Explore supplier, purchase and procurement workflows.
buyer_guidance: Distinguish vendor research, purchase-order drafting and commitments. Verify budget limits, supplier identity and approval before binding a purchase.
seo_title: Procurement agents: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore supplier, purchase and procurement workflows.

title: Science and research agents
intro: Explore systems for research and scientific workflows.
buyer_guidance: Record the research question, methods, sources and reproducibility artifacts. A proposed experiment is different from a completed laboratory result.
seo_title: Science and research agents: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore systems for research and scientific workflows.

title: Agent security, evaluation and observability
intro: Explore security operations, agent inspection, tracing and evaluation.
buyer_guidance: Separate observations from verdicts. Compare the scope of each scan or evaluation, tested versions and how failures are reproduced.
seo_title: Agent security, evaluation and observability: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore security operations, agent inspection, tracing and evaluation.

title: Agent frameworks and platforms
intro: Explore tooling for building, deploying and operating agents.
buyer_guidance: Compare deployment, state, orchestration, tool permissions and operating costs. Framework support is not proof that a deployed agent inherits every capability.
seo_title: Agent frameworks and platforms: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore tooling for building, deploying and operating agents.

title: MCP servers and integrations
intro: Find published tools and connections for agent applications.
buyer_guidance: Inspect the tool schema, transport, authentication, scopes and write effects. Registry presence does not establish security, maintenance or runtime compatibility.
seo_title: MCP servers and integrations: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Find published tools and connections for agent applications.

title: Agent skills
intro: Explore reusable skill specifications, packs and individual skills.
buyer_guidance: Check the exact skill path and revision, dependencies and execution permissions. A skill pack may contain several separate skills with different operating requirements.
seo_title: Agent skills: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore reusable skill specifications, packs and individual skills.

title: Agent payments and commerce
intro: Explore payment protocols, wallets, authorization and commerce services.
buyer_guidance: Separate discovery, authorization, settlement and delivery acceptance. Confirm network, asset, fees and spend controls for the exact implementation.
seo_title: Agent payments and commerce: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore payment protocols, wallets, authorization and commerce services.

title: Agent discovery and task markets
intro: Explore registries, capability schemas and places to find services or work.
buyer_guidance: Treat a listing as a discovery lead. Check who operates the service, whether it is active, how work is accepted and whether payment claims are independently observable.
seo_title: Agent discovery and task markets: capabilities and evidence | BasedAgents
meta_description: Explore registries, capability schemas and places to find services or work.
